prompt: A car travels $180$ miles in $3$ hours at a constant speed. What is its speed, in miles per hour?
hint: "Per hour" means divide by the number of hours.

hints.text: "Per hour" means divide by the number of hours.

learningObjective: Compute a unit rate from a total and a quantity.
explanation: A rate "per hour" is the total distance divided by the total time.
The units confirm the setup: miles ÷ hours gives miles per hour.

alternativeExplanations.title: Let the units tell you the operation
steps: You want an answer in miles/hour — a fraction with miles on top and hours on the bottom.
So write $\dfrac{180 \text{ miles}}{3 \text{ hours}}$ and the operation is decided for you.
On any rate question, writing the target units first prevents dividing the wrong way round.
